opportunities.name: Resy special-event ticket booking
opportunities.description: Book a ticketed Resy special event (e.g. a dinner or experience) by choosing the event from the Special Events & Experiences list for a city, selecting a ticket quantity, choosing a ticket type or time slot, and confirming the reservation.
steps: Open the Resy page for the target city and go to Special Events & Experiences (or click See more venues there).
Click the event card whose title matches the target event.
On the event page, open the ticket-quantity dropdown and select the number of tickets.
Click the ticket option or time slot to book (e.g. 'Book Now' for a membership ticket, or the time button such as '5:00 PM').
In the 'Complete Your Reservation' dialog, check the order summary and click 'Reserve Now'.
parameters: ticket type or time slot (e.g. Centurion Member Access, 5:00 PM)

instances.values: Miami; event 'Thursday, May 4th | American Express Presents CARBONE BEACH 2023'; quantity 3 Tickets; ticket 'Centurion® Member Access to CARBONE BEACH: 5/4' via Book Now; confirmed with Reserve Now. The two segments are split by unrelated Amex careers and MBTA ferry work. The NEXT click at t=520.0 is on an Amex careers page and is excluded.
Atlanta; event 'HAPPY HOUR BURGER' (Aria, Thu Apr 13 2023 5:00 PM); quantity 1 Ticket; time slot 5:00 PM; confirmed with Reserve Now. Split by an REI deals detour at t=618.8–640.9.

opportunities.name: NPS find-a-park by state
opportunities.description: Pick a US state from the National Park Service 'Find a Park by State' dropdown, then open a listed park, heritage area or monument and follow one of its information links.
steps: Click the 'Find a Park by State...' dropdown on the NPS homepage.
Click the target state in the list.
On the state results page, click the target park or site entry.
Click the required sub-page link on that entry, e.g. 'Current Conditions', 'Basic Information', or the heritage area link.
parameters: park or site name on the state page
sub-page link (e.g. Basic Information, Current Conditions, Alerts)

instances.values: state = Alaska (dropdown opened and Alaska chosen).
state = Florida, then 'Current Conditions »', then '1 National Heritage Area »', then the 'Kenai Mountains-Turnagain Arm National Heritage Area' link.
state = California, then the 'Basic Information »' link on the California National Historic Trail entry.

opportunities.name: Megabus bus tracker lookup
opportunities.description: Track a Megabus bus by entering a service number, or by location, on the Track your Bus page reached through 'Check my bus' and 'Track my bus'.
steps: Click 'Check my bus' in the top navigation.
Type the service number or location code into the search field.
If a suggestion appears, select it, then click 'Find my bus'.
parameters: service number (e.g. 5456165184) or location search term (e.g. SE4)
suggestion chosen from the autocomplete list, if any

instances.values: service number = 5456165184 (typed; no Find my bus click recorded).
search term = SE4, autocomplete suggestion selected at t=569.6, then 'Find my bus' clicked. Split by a REI deals detour at t=544.1–554.3.
